messages:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — drafting a lightweight gating checklist for SI co-sell leads entering marketplace + hardware partner opportunities. Need rules for claim windows, ownership handoff, and account stitching. TL;DR: propose 48h claim window, two-touch SLA, territory carve by ARR band. Thoughts?
Ben Ortiz: +1 to 48h. what's the tie-breaker when two partners claim the same lead?
Maria Chen: Priority = first-claim timestamp, then engagement score (meetings > demos > doc views). If still tied, product-ops triage within 24h. Also propose adding a shared `partner_claim` tag in CRM.
Jon Patel: agree. For the account stitching piece, can we use the external_id + domain canonicalization to dedupe? e.g. run `crm.find_match(external_id, domain)` as pre-check before assigning.
Leila Gomez: Also callout for joint announcements: both partners must sign MOU + marketing approval before co-listing in cloud marketplaces. No soft-launches without legal signoff.
Rachel Kim: Can we add a 'no-touch' override for enterprise accounts (ARR > 1M)? Rule: if ARR>1M assign to Redwood AE unless partner has signed MOU with explicit account carve.
Maria Chen: yes — that'll be in the matrix. I'll add ARR bands: <100k = open-claim, 100k-1M = partner-first by claim, >1M = AE-first unless MOU.
Ben Ortiz: I'll run a pilot: 20 leads from last quarter, apply 48h claim window + the ARR bands. I'll report conflict rate and abandoned-claim metric.
Jon Patel: small suggestion — add a quick adjudication endpoint for ops:
```
POST /partner-claims/adjudicate
{ "lead_id": "1234", "claimants": ["PartnerA", "PartnerB"], "tie_reason": "same-score" }
```
Ops can mark resolution and add note.
Leila Gomez: tagging legal + marketplace folks for review. @Rachel Kim please confirm marketplace listing checklist (images, co-branding rules).
Rachel Kim: confirmed — need partner logo permission + co-brand guidelines doc signed before listing. I'll add to the checklist.
deploy-bot: New confluence doc created: https://confluence.redwood.company/partnerships/si-co-sell-guardrails (draft)
Maria Chen: perfect — I'll draft the short playbook and a one-pager for partner onboarding. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Ben Ortiz: I'll volunteer to be on the pilot run and help instrument metrics.
Maria Chen: awesome — assigning action items in the doc.
Maria Chen: (later) tagging final reviewers: @Leila Gomez, @Rachel Kim — aim to lock by EOD Fri.
